title: add pre-pull prep DaemonSet and pluggable hook concurrency profiles with explicit values schema
author: Evan Brooks
description:
Motivation: On air-gapped and on-prem installs we've seen repeated customer incidents where image pull latency or registry throttling causes init hooks (migrations, seed jobs) to time out and cascade to full upgrade failures. This PR introduces two coordinated mitigations: (1) an optional, namespaced prepull DaemonSet that warms nodes with OCI images used by init hooks and core pods; and (2) a pluggable hook concurrency profile model in values.yaml that lets operators control per-hook concurrency, max parallelism and backoff policies.

Scope/what's included: Added a new top-level values schema section `prepull` describing enabled, nodeSelector, tolerations and image list. Introduced `hookConcurrencyProfiles` under `initHooks` which maps profile names to {parallelism, maxRetries, backoffSeconds, jitterPct}. Hook templates now accept `{{ .Values.initHooks.defaultProfile }}` and template helpers in `templates/_hook_helpers.tpl` choose the appropriate job spec. Added a post-upgrade drift-detection Job (disabled by default) that checks ConfigMap and Secret checksums to detect out-of-band changes and emits a Kubernetes event for operator attention. Documentation and values schema examples are included in `values.schema.json` and `values-examples/prepull-and-concurrency.md`.

Design notes: The prepull DaemonSet is opt-in and sets `imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent` by default. It is provided as a lightweight init-time preparer (not long-running) and will be removed after successful node-level image cache verification. For safety the DaemonSet will be created with `ttlSecondsAfterFinished` via a companion Job that coordinates deletion for clusters that support it; otherwise it leaves the DaemonSet with a configurable `cleanup: true/false`.

Migration guidance: For clusters currently relying on global init jobs, operators should start with `prepull.enabled: true`, supply the minimal image list (core images only) and run a cluster preflight (we added a `helm template` check target). Operators upgrading from older charts will have `initHooks.defaultProfile` implicitly set to `serial` (parallelism=1) if not provided to preserve behavior.

Testing: Unit tests for template helpers added (helm unittest). CI runs `helm template` and our internal `preflight` script that lint-checks the new schema. Manual verification performed on a k8s 1.25 cluster (GKE private) using an air-gapped registry mirror to validate prepull and cleanup behavior.

Rollout and rollback: This change is backward compatible (values defaults retain previous semantics). If an operator enables `prepull` and experiences issues, disabling it reverts to legacy path. The PR includes a safe rollback annotation on the DaemonSet deletion Job to avoid race conditions during rapid rollbacks.

Checklist: - [x] Values schema and examples added - [x] Templates updated to reference profiles and helper functions - [x] Helm unittest coverage for helper functions - [x] Docs: values-examples and upgrade notes - [x] CI: helm lint + template + unit tests

Related: ENG-9834 (reduce upgrade flakiness for on-prem), ENG-9902 (hook orchestration improvements).

release_notes: Add optional prepull DaemonSet to warm node image cache and introduce init hook concurrency profiles under initHooks. New values schema and examples included. Backward compatible defaults retained.
notes_for_ops: If enabling prepull, populate `prepull.images` with minimal core images (api, controller, init-hooks images). Monitor node disk and imagepull metrics. Use `helm upgrade --set prepull.enabled=false` to disable quickly.
